$comment: Accepted-risk npm-audit advisories. The CI gate in
scripts/check-audit.js compares current audit output against this
file. An entry blesses ONE advisory (by GHSA id) against ONE
package — same GHSA on a different package needs its own entry.
Every entry is required to carry the full triage context; the
gate refuses to load a partial entry.
Required fields:
- ghsa, package, severity, title  (identification + triage)
- rationale  (why this is acceptable risk; security decision)
- nodes      (non-empty array of `node_modules/...` paths;
the gate requires the current audit's `nodes`
for this advisory to be a subset; a new path
fails the gate)
- scope      ("dev" | "prod" | "both"; the dependency-tree
context the bless applies to. The gate runs
`npm audit --omit=dev` to compute current scope;
if a baseline says "dev" but the advisory now
appears in the prod-only audit, the gate fails
with a "scope escalation" error.)
Adding entries: only when the advisory has been triaged and the
risk is understood (e.g., a moderate ReDoS in a dev-only
markdown linter that runs on trusted internal markdown).
Removing entries: when the advisory is actually fixed in our deps
(then the gate flips to clean, the entry becomes dead, and we
delete it).
Baseline established 2026-05-11 alongside the gate's introduction.
Refresh process documented in CONTRIBUTING.md > Supply-Chain
Pinning > npm audit baseline.

accepted.title: brace-expansion: Zero-step sequence causes process hang and memory exhaustion
accepted.rationale: Transitive dev-only. brace-expansion@1.x reaches us via the minimatch@3.x → glob@7.x chain used by jest tooling and markdownlint-cli2. The vulnerable path is only exercised against trusted glob patterns hard-coded in package.json scripts (`markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md"` and jest's test discovery), never against untrusted brace strings. Production server doesn't depend on brace-expansion. Verified dev-only by `npm audit --omit=dev` returning zero advisories for this package. Accepted until the jest + markdownlint chains publish updates that pull in a fixed brace-expansion. If a runtime dep later pulls in brace-expansion, the prod-only audit will flag it and the gate's scope check will fail until re-triaged.

accepted.title: js-yaml has prototype pollution in merge (<<)
accepted.rationale: Transitive dev-only. js-yaml@4.1.0 reaches us via markdownlint-cli2; js-yaml@3.14.2 reaches us via jest's @jest/core → @jest/transform → babel-plugin-istanbul → @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config chain (newly hoisted to a top-level node_modules/js-yaml path). Both only parse trusted repo-local YAML (.markdownlint.json/.yaml, jest's nyc config) in dev, never user-supplied YAML at runtime. Production server doesn't import js-yaml. Verified dev-only by `npm audit --omit=dev` returning zero advisories for this package. Accepted until both chains upgrade past js-yaml@4.1.1.

accepted.title: JS-YAML: Quadratic-complexity DoS in merge key handling via repeated aliases
accepted.rationale: Same dev-only chains as GHSA-MH29-5H37-FV8M (markdownlint-cli2's js-yaml@4.1.0 and jest's istanbul nyc-config chain's js-yaml@3.14.2). Only parses trusted repo-local YAML, never attacker-controlled aliases. Verified dev-only by `npm audit --omit=dev` returning zero advisories for this package. Accepted until both chains upgrade past js-yaml@4.1.1.

accepted.title: markdown-it has a Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
accepted.rationale: Transitive dev-only via markdownlint-cli2 → markdownlint → markdown-it. Only parses repo-local trusted markdown during lint. Production server doesn't render markdown. Verified dev-only by `npm audit --omit=dev`. Accepted until markdownlint upgrades.

accepted.title: markdown-it: Quadratic complexity DoS in smartquotes rule via replaceAt string operations
accepted.rationale: Same dev-only chain as GHSA-38C4-R59V-3VQW (markdownlint-cli2 → markdownlint → markdown-it). Only parses repo-local trusted markdown during lint, never attacker-controlled input. Verified dev-only by `npm audit --omit=dev` returning zero advisories for this package. Accepted until markdownlint upgrades.
